title: Learning the Integral of a Diffusion Model
summary: A technical deep-dive exploring the mathematical relationship between diffusion models and flow matching, specifically focusing on understanding the integral/form of diffusion processes through flow maps. The article provides theoretical insights into how these generative AI techniques are mathematically connected.
problem_solved: Explains the mathematical foundations connecting diffusion models to flow matching by learning their integral representation.
why_valuable: Provides researchers and practitioners with deeper theoretical understanding of diffusion models, enabling better intuition for model design and optimization.
